text:

The title of this Data Source is: 勝手に百人町マップスポットDB
The description of this Data Source is: Notionをスポット正本として、名古屋市東区「武家屋敷散策コース」の全地点と、まほろばの実訪問スポットを管理する。地図は派生表示。『公式資料掲載』は『実際に訪問済み』を意味しない。緯度経度・公開許諾・情報鮮度は実査で確認。外部公開は別Human Gate。

<sqlite-table>
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "collection://16c7c12b-396e-4de5-b55a-36fe7c44c07b" (
	url TEXT UNIQUE,
	createdTime TEXT, -- ISO-8601 datetime string, automatically set. This is the canonical time for when the page was created.
	"date:確認日:start" TEXT, -- ISO-8601 date or datetime string. Use the expanded property (date:<column_name>:start) to set this value.
	"date:確認日:end" TEXT, -- ISO-8601 date or datetime string, can be empty. Must be NULL if the date is a single date, and must be present if the date is a range. Use the expanded property (date:<column_name>:end) to set this value.
	"date:確認日:is_datetime" INTEGER, -- 1 if the date is a datetime, 0 if it is a date, NULL defaults to 0. Use the expanded property (date:<column_name>:is_datetime) to set this value.
	"緯度" FLOAT,
	"経度" FLOAT,
	"掲載区分" TEXT, -- one of ["公式順路", "公式町並み", "公式拡大図", "周辺参考", "まほろば実訪問"]
	"Googleマップ" TEXT,
	"公式記号" TEXT,
	"一次出典" TEXT,
	"エリア" TEXT, -- one of ["白壁・主税・橦木", "百人町・黒門・城番", "筒井・新出来", "周辺・拡張"]
	"訪問状況" TEXT, -- one of ["未照合", "訪問済", "未訪問"]
	"所在地" TEXT,
	"コース番号" FLOAT,
	"確認メモ" TEXT,
	"紹介文" TEXT,
	"テーマ" TEXT, -- one of ["歴史・建築", "町並み・路地", "寺社・信仰", "文化・美術", "飲食・喫茶", "公園・自然", "百人町活動"]
	"まほろばの一言" TEXT,
	"写真" TEXT, -- JSON array of zero or more file IDs, Notion Folder URLs, or <folder> tags copied from fetch output. Folders are stored as native Folder references.
	"公開判断" TEXT, -- one of ["非公開下書き", "要確認", "掲載可"]
	"スポット名" TEXT
)
</sqlite-table>
